text:
Maya (partnerships): Partner asked for marketplace listing + private offer combo. They want listing fee waived, a single billed SKU conversion, and a 2-year step-down renewal. Thoughts?
Jon (marketplace): OK to combine. Fee waiver could be conditioned on commit + co-sell targets. Suggest waive if >= $350k ARR and 3 verified co-sell wins in year 1.
Asha (hw-partner): Our channel needs predictable metering. Can you publish embeddings_unit and gen_token SKUs and provide a one-page conversion table? They want a flat 1:8 conversion for simplicity.
Sam (revops): Prefer keeping both SKUs live and an appendix mapping conversions for invoicing. Flat 1:8 can skew AR if usage mixes differ; add a volatility clause.
Ruth (legal): Include precedence clause: private-offer pricing overrides public listing only for the explicit term and SKUs listed. Also add audit and data-request rights.
Maya (partnerships): Partner also asks for SI onboarding credits (one-time) plus 6% ongoing co-sell credit. Can we afford that?
Sam (revops): One-time SI onboarding credit OK (cap it to $15k or 5% of Y1 commit, whichever lower). 6% ongoing is doable but payable on closed net ARR and subject to verification.
Asha (hw-partner): Need visibility in marketplace. What visibility-for-commit bands can we offer?
Jon (marketplace): Propose bands: <$250k standard; $250-500k featured slot 30d; >$500k featured + category push (90d) + co-marketing fund 1.5% of commit.
Maya (partnerships): Partner wants a renewal step-down schedule: year2 discount lower by 3% than year1, then market-indexed. We should protect against market swings.
Ruth (legal): Add 12-month renewal price protection post-term. After that apply a market index +/- 3%. Also include a clause allowing renegotiation for material market changes.
Sam (revops): Recommend an onboarding escrow: 8% of Y1 commit held and released on milestone usage thresholds to smooth revenue; also caps potential write-offs to 10% of commit.
Asha (hw-partner): No chargebacks first 4 months while channel ramps.
Maya (partnerships): We can do a 4-month soft window: advisory true-ups months 5-8, hard reconciliation after month 8.
Jon (marketplace): Tech note: marketplace requires mapping of private SKU ids to public entitlements to ensure metering. Add SKUID appendix in offer.
Ruth (legal): Add clawback language if partner fails to provide reports within 45 days of request. Add bilateral termination remedy if fraud detected.
Sam (revops): Need to model cashflow impact; will produce a pro forma showing escrow, co-marketing, and SI credit impacts.
Maya (partnerships): Announcement timing: partner wants press at signature. We prefer staged: signing announcement + full case study after 2 customers or 60 days. Include embargo and approval flow.
Asha (hw-partner): Staged announce OK if we get a signed quote for the first joint customer within 60 days.
ops-bot: Reminder: file private-offer in #marketplace-deals and attach SKU appendix and starter term sheet.
Maya (partnerships): Action items: Jon confirm visibility band ops + technical SKU requirements (due Mon). Sam run pro forma + write-off cap scenarios (due Tue). Ruth draft precedence + clawback + audit clauses (due Tue). Asha share SI onboarding deliverables and verification process (due Wed). Next sync Fri 9am PT.
Jon (marketplace): Will check marketplace TOS and share constraints.
Sam (revops): On the pro forma now.
Ruth (legal): Drafting clauses and will circulate redlines.
Maya (partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll assemble starter term sheet after inputs and loop marketing for announce gating.
